concept.cypher: MATCH (type:Type) WHERE type.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.banking_microservices.' AND type.fqn CONTAINS '.controller.' SET type:SpringBank:Controller RETURN type
MATCH (type:Type) WHERE type.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.banking_microservices.' AND type.fqn CONTAINS '.service.' SET type:SpringBank:Service RETURN type
MATCH (type:Type) WHERE type.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.banking_microservices.' AND type.fqn CONTAINS '.repository.' SET type:SpringBank:Repository RETURN type

concept.description: Labels persistence models and domain entities.
concept.cypher: MATCH (type:Type) WHERE type.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.banking_microservices.' AND (type.fqn CONTAINS '.model.' OR type.fqn CONTAINS '.domain.') SET type:SpringBank:PersistenceModel RETURN type

constraint.description: Controllers must use application services and must not access repositories directly.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (controller:SpringBank:Controller)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(repository:SpringBank:Repository) RETURN controller.fqn AS Controller, repository.fqn AS Repository

constraint.description: Services and repositories must not depend on the HTTP adapter layer.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (inner)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(controller:SpringBank:Controller) WHERE inner:SpringBank:Service OR inner:SpringBank:Repository OR inner:SpringBank:PersistenceModel RETURN inner.fqn AS InnerType, controller.fqn AS Controller

constraint.description: HTTP controllers must exchange API DTOs instead of persistence entities.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (controller:SpringBank:Controller)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(model:SpringBank:PersistenceModel) RETURN controller.fqn AS Controller, model.fqn AS PersistenceModel

constraint.description: Business code must use an injected Clock instead of the host default clock.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (owner:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(caller:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(clockMethod:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(clockType:Type) WHERE owner.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.banking_microservices.' AND ((clockType.fqn = 'java.time.LocalDateTime' AND clockMethod.name = 'now') OR (clockType.fqn = 'java.time.ZoneId' AND clockMethod.name = 'systemDefault')) RETURN owner.fqn AS Type, caller.name AS Method, clockType.fqn AS ClockType, clockMethod.name AS ClockMethod
